cards.card_text: Paul says that builder “will be saved, but only as if through the flames.” Then Paul turns to the Corinthians and talks about a building where God’s Spirit dwells.
cards.verse_text: If it is burned up, he will suffer loss. He himself will be saved, but only as if through the flames. Do you not know that you yourselves are God’s temple, and that God’s Spirit dwells in you?
